**Finding: missing** (INSURANCE, low severity) — redline validated and submitted.

- **What I checked:** A document-wide search for "insurance" surfaced only Net Sales deduction language (p0101) and health-payer references (p0102). Article XVI (Indemnification; Recalls, p0715–p0733) ends with the recall mechanics and contains no coverage covenant; General Provisions likewise has none.
- **Why it matters:** Array bears real risk-facing obligations toward Ono — it conducts Clinical Studies (including under Joint Development Plans), manufactures and supplies Product under Article IX, and indemnifies Ono for Products Liability Claims and clinical trial injury/death under Section 16.2 — yet nothing requires it to carry insurance backing those indemnities. Total absence falls below the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) and into walk-away territory.
- **Fix:** Inserted a new Section 16.7 immediately after the recall provision at the preferred limits, adapted to the pharma context: CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate; product liability including clinical trial liability USD 2M; cyber/privacy USD 5M where Array handles our Confidential Information or personal data; statutory workers' compensation; certificates and change notification on request, with a self-insurance option to keep the ask proportionate.
- **Negotiation room flagged in the comment:** we can make the clause mutual or drop to the fallback limits (USD 1M product liability / USD 2M cyber).
